snippet.title: Powwow Bound: A Menominee Homecoming Demo Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Powwow Bound: A Menominee Homecoming is a 3D story-based adventure game about a Menominee family going back to their reservation in Wisconsin for the yearly contest powwow.  You play as Deborah Jo (DJ), who learns about her mother's past with the powwow dance circle through interactive story moments and culturally influenced minigames.

 There are rhythm-based activities that teach traditional dancing skills and photography features that show replicated places from the real Menominee Reservation.  It's a personal narrative about family, culture, and celebrating your roots.

 Minimum System Requirements

 Windows XP is the operating system.

 Any processor

 RAM: 1 GB

 Graphics: Any

 Storage: 1 GB of free space This video contains gameplay footage of the game mentioned in the title. 
The gameplay is recorded and shared for commentary, review, and educational purposes. 
All rights to the game and its content belong to the respective copyright holders. 
Music and sound effects that may trigger Content ID have been removed or replaced where possible.
